days.name: Push 1
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic: arm circles × 10; cable external rotations × 10 per arm.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Ramp up in warm-up sets, then take one heavy top set of 3-5 reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Larsen Press
exercises.notes: Legs straight out on the floor. No leg drive.

exercises.name: Press-Around
exercises.notes: Superset with Pec Stretch. Go straight into the stretch without resting.

exercises.name: Pec Stretch
exercises.notes: Closes the Press-Around superset. Log the hold in seconds: 30 sec. Rest after this one.

exercises.name: Squeeze-Only Triceps Pressdown
exercises.notes: Contracted half of the range only. Superset with Stretch-Only Overhead Triceps Extension. Go straight into it without resting.

exercises.name: Stretch-Only Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.notes: Stretched half of the range only. Closes the Squeeze-Only Triceps Pressdown superset. Rest after this one.

days.name: Pull 1
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic: arm circles × 10; cable external rotations × 10 per arm.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Sets 1-4 are feeders, one step apart: set 1 at RPE 4-5; set 2 at RPE 6-7; set 3 at RPE 7-8; set 4 at RPE 10. Set 5 goes to failure, then drop the weight 30% and go again. Tap a set number to mark the feeders as warm-ups.

exercises.name: Omni-Grip Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a different grip on each set.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.notes: Stretched half of the range only. Superset with Lat Stretch. Go straight into the stretch without resting.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: Closes the Bottom-Half Dumbbell Pullover superset. Log the hold in seconds: 30 sec per side. Rest after this one, then start the pair again.

exercises.name: Omni-Directional Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Change the cable height each set: set 1 low to high; set 2 straight on; set 3 high to low.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Dumbbell Preacher Curl
exercises.notes: Stretched half of the range only.

days.name: Legs 1
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic (about 2 min): front-to-back leg swings; side-to-side leg swings; side-lying twists; step-throughs.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.notes: Ramp first: 20% × 10; 35% × 5; 55% × 3; 70% × 2; 80% × 1. Working sets are 2-4 reps at 85-90% of your 1RM.

exercises.name: Paused Squat
exercises.notes: 75% of your working weight. Pause in the hole on every rep.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: 10 reps per leg. Keep the depth on the last steps — do not cut them short.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Change foot position each set: set 1 toes out; set 2 toes in; set 3 neutral.

exercises.name: Leg Press Toe Press
exercises.notes: Change foot position each set: set 1 neutral; set 2 toes out; set 3 toes in; set 4 neutral.

days.name: Push 2
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic: general stretches.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Three warm-up sets first: 10 reps; 4 reps; 3 reps. Then set 1 moderate for 8; set 2 heavy for 5; set 3 light for 15.

exercises.name: Floor-Reset Skullcrusher
exercises.notes: Rest the bar on the floor between reps.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Reps 1-5 with a slow negative; reps 6-20 with constant tension.

exercises.name: Plate Front Raise
exercises.notes: Rotate the plate inwards at the top.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.notes: AMRAP: one set to failure. The rep range is only a guide.

days.name: Pull 2
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic: arm circles × 10; cable external rotations × 10 per arm.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: 12-15 reps per arm.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: AMRAP: one set to failure. The rep range is only a guide.

exercises.name: Kroc Row
exercises.notes: 10-12 reps per arm.

days.name: Legs 2
days.notes:
General: 5-10 min on the treadmill or Stairmaster.
Dynamic (about 2 min): front-to-back leg swings; side-to-side leg swings; side-lying twists; step-throughs.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Ramp first: 30% × 8; 50% × 4; 75% × 2; 90% × 1. Then take one working set of 5 reps.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.notes: 50-60% of your Deadlift working weight.

exercises.name: Slow-Eccentric Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Lower slowly on every rep.
